name: ishortn
title: iShortn
description: Shorten links with iShortn and view their click analytics.
author: kelvin_amoaba

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your iShortn API key. Create one in Settings → API Keys (Pro or Ultra plan).

preferences.name: defaultDomain
preferences.title: Default Domain
preferences.description: Domain for new links, and for Link Analytics when you enter only an alias. A platform domain such as isht.app or an active custom domain. Leave empty to use your account's default domain.

commands.name: shorten-link
commands.title: Shorten Link
commands.description: Shorten a URL with an optional custom alias and domain

commands.name: shorten-clipboard-url
commands.title: Shorten Clipboard URL
commands.description: Shorten the URL in your clipboard and copy the short link

commands.name: link-analytics
commands.title: Link Analytics
commands.description: View clicks, top countries, devices and referrers for a short link
